raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #8756

`timed_op` called `get_accelerator().synchronize()` for every wrapped comm op whenever comms logging was enabled. Ops not selected by `prof_ops`, `prof_all` or `prof` get no timer and no record, so the sync was pure overhead.

The sync is now guarded by `should_profile`. The MPI `cdb.barrier()` is unchanged.

Test: `test_collective_profiling` now counts `synchronize()` calls. It must be 0 for the `unselected` case and 1 for `prof_all`, `prof`, and both `prof_ops` cases. Without the fix the 8 `unselected` cases fail; with it all 52 tests in `test_comms_logger.py` pass. yapf is clean.

Verified on a node with A40 GPUs, but the tests use a mocked backend and accelerator, so no GPU was exercised. Not verified: real NCCL/MPI runs, training step timing, or the rest of the unit test suite.

Thanks to @marcusacosta for the report.

This change was prepared by an automated AI agent (Claude) and verified as described above.

detail.body:
Fixes #8756

`timed_op` called `get_accelerator().synchronize()` for every wrapped comm op whenever comms logging was enabled. Ops not selected by `prof_ops`, `prof_all` or `prof` get no timer and no record, so the sync was pure overhead.

The sync is now guarded by `should_profile`. The MPI `cdb.barrier()` is unchanged.

Test: `test_collective_profiling` now counts `synchronize()` calls. It must be 0 for the `unselected` case and 1 for `prof_all`, `prof`, and both `prof_ops` cases. Without the fix the 8 `unselected` cases fail; with it all 52 tests in `test_comms_logger.py` pass. yapf is clean.

Verified on a node with A40 GPUs, but the tests use a mocked backend and accelerator, so no GPU was exercised. Not verified: real NCCL/MPI runs, training step timing, or the rest of the unit test suite.

Thanks to @marcusacosta for the report.

This change was prepared by an automated AI agent (Claude) and verified as described above.
detail.title: Skip accelerator sync for unprofiled comm ops

files.patch:
@@ -130,7 +130,8 @@ def log_wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
         finally:
             if comms_logger.enabled:
                 # Need to make op blocking for accurate logging
-                get_accelerator().synchronize()
+                if should_profile:
+                    get_accelerator().synchronize()
                 # If we're using MPI, we can't simply sync the stream
                 if cdb.using_mpi:
                     cdb.barrier()

@@ -111,7 +111,8 @@ def test_collective_profiling(monkeypatch, op_name, positional, debug, profile_m
     backend = SimpleNamespace(using_mpi=False, is_initialized=lambda: True, get_world_size=lambda group=None: 2)
     setattr(backend, op_name, backend_op)
     monkeypatch.setattr(comm, 'cdb', backend)
-    monkeypatch.setattr(comm, 'get_accelerator', lambda: SimpleNamespace(synchronize=lambda: None))
+    synchronize = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(comm, 'get_accelerator', lambda: SimpleNamespace(synchronize=synchronize))
     op_timer = Mock()
     op_timer.elapsed.return_value = 1.0
     timers = Mock(return_value=op_timer)
@@ -151,7 +152,9 @@ def test_collective_profiling(monkeypatch, op_name, positional, debug, profile_m
     if profile_mode == 'unselected':
         assert comm.comms_logger.comms_dict == {}
         timers.assert_not_called()
+        synchronize.assert_not_called()
     else:
+        synchronize.assert_called_once_with()
         record_name, = comm.comms_logger.comms_dict
         if debug:
             assert record_name.startswith(log_name + ' | [Caller Func: ')
